resources.string: Tap a landmark to learn about it
Move along the orbit to explore days. The slider also works.
The sun anchors the start of the cycle. Day 1 is the first day of your period.
The moon represents the ending and transition towards a new cycle. It does not predict the exact day your next period will start.
Your cycle is longer than the estimate. Today’s marker stays at the end of the path; a new cycle has not been assumed.
